ranjit (Nebula): Quick shout — onboarding demo tomorrow. Our SPA fires ~80 parallel SDK inits on first interaction and ~4-7% of preflight handshakes return 429. UX blocked for a subset.

jo (CSE): Is that preflight token mint or model call? Any error snippet?

ranjit (Nebula): Preflight. Example: `HTTP/1.1 429` body `{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"retry_after\":1}` headers include `x-request-id` and `x-rw-rate-window:60s`. Ramp 0->80 in ~25s.

lee (eng): Sounds like a preflight fanout (ephemeral tokens per session). Quick mitigations: debounce init (200ms), short client token cache (20-30s), and jittered retry on 429.

jo (CSE): Also check if you're creating tokens on multiple subdomains/tabs — cache scope matters.

ranjit (Nebula): We're minting per session per tab currently. SDK v0.9.2. Can you toss a tiny snippet for coalescing & cache?

lee (eng): Sure, tiny pattern:```
let pending=null;
async function mintOnce(){ if(pending) return pending; pending = mint(); try{return await pending}finally{pending=null} }
let cache={val:null,exp:0};
async function getToken(){ if(Date.now()<cache.exp) return cache.val; const t = await mintOnce(); cache = {val:t, exp:Date.now()+30000}; return t }
```

jo (CSE): If you need immediate relief we can request a temporary preflight bump. Zoe, please advise on renewal risk and ops escalation.

zoe (CSM): If demo fails this week theres a modest renewal risk; I'll join the demo. Jo, can you open ops ticket and check account headroom?

jo (CSE): Opening ops escalation. ops-bot please create ticket for account "Nebula" — temporary preflight burst for 2026-03-22 17:00 UTC demo.

ops-bot: Escalation created: ESC-2799-NEB-12 — ops asked for domain + expected peak and ETA for confirmation ~2h.

ranjit (Nebula): Domain: nebula.app. Expected peak: 200 concurrent within 60s. We'll patch coalescing+cache and run a synthetic. Will attach logs (x-request-id).

lee (eng): Great. Add retry with exponential backoff + jitter in preflight path. After you run synthetic attach the logs and we'll correlate.

ranjit (Nebula): Patch in staging now. First synthetic: 200 concurrent -> 0.9% 429 (was ~5%). Attaching snippet.

jo (CSE): Ops escalation tagged high-priority and renewal owner included. Tracking checklist: [ ] patch deployed, [ ] synthetic logs, [ ] ops approval, [ ] demo smoke. Tag me when ready.

zoe (CSM): I'll be on the demo call and can field customer concerns. If ops does not confirm the bump in 1 hour I'll escalate to AM.

lee (eng): Logging an internal ticket to add adaptive client preflight coalescing for browser SDKs to avoid future storms.

ranjit (Nebula): Thanks all, will update thread with final smoke results.
